chunks.text: Samsung S10 refurbished. We carried the S10 to our cellular provider. They changed the SIM card, moved data and the phone is fully functional (to the best of my knowledge) and my wife is happy.

The best phone for its price!. Overall, the Samsung Galaxy s10 is an amazing phone. A 6.1 inch screen and very lightweight at 5.54oz. Resolution is great, it powers on very quickly and runs smoothly! My only problem was, the screen flickers every now and then. So I decided that I would return it. According to the UPS tracking number, my return has been delivered since June 1, 2020. Today is June 23rd, I have not yet received my refund. I have tried calling Amazon, but just a recording message only. I have never experienced such a long period for a refund, please help!
Samsung s10. So far its been great. Very lightweight. Battery life seems good. Quite fast upgrading from s6.

Renewed Galaxy s10 128GB. I received the phone at a great time and I have not had any issues since I purchased it in October. The battery life is great and it does well with my phone service, too. The camera is not too great in certain lighting, however.

Samsung S10. This phone feels nice in the hand. The screen can be seen in direct sunlight. The OS is easy to figure out. The only exception the questionable things are that the phone is light. It feels,... too light. And the battery doesn't last quite as long as I would like.

No bueno.. Although we did receive the s10, the battery life was terrible. It came charged at 75%, within a couple hours it was dead and would take almost a full week plugged in to charge to 100%. We were not offered a replacement, however, the phone was sent back and we were given a full refund.

Samsung S10 5G is rocket science bar none. It runs with retro rockets fired, the way I always dreamed a PC, laptop or cellphone should work. Its unbelievable instantaneous response is out of this world. I have been God smacked. I've had cellphones since their infancy, nothing compared, I can't say enough !
Galaxy S10. Works and looks brand new, no problems so far!
Galaxy S10 is more reliable than my iPhone was.. Last summer I bought a Samsung Galaxy laptop computer. This phone, S10, synchs very well with the computer.

As for the performance of the S10, I'm quite sure I could get at least 1 day of use of this phone if I lowered my usage a bit and used the screen at the 1080p or 720p resolution. After the recent Android 10 update, which gave this lineup of phones many more features that can also be found on the new S20 lineup, I'd say you should also consider this phone, as on average, these will be around $200-400 less than its younger counterpart and you will recieve similar features. One last thing to note, however, (and maybe this is just me incorrectly using the phone) is that the fingerprint reader usually takes a good bit to read (about 3 seconds for me, which is a lot more than what I'm used to from my S8) and semi-frequently fails to read my print at all.
